life_path.event: Methadone maintenance held at 30ml at a fixed 16:00 supervised slot. Taper deferred pending clinical review and naloxone issued at dispense (t1-i6, t2-i6, t3-i5). The withdrawal-window overdose exposure created by the self-requested taper is suppressed.
life_path.headline: Maintenance Dose Stabilised

life_path.event: With the background flag quietly cleared (t3-i5), the Carnegie Library 'Reading Buddies' registration resumes and a supervised volunteer placement begins. Uptake depends on library staff completing the review.
life_path.headline: Volunteer Placement Resumed

life_path.event: The 18-month suspension period from the April 2052 handling conviction lapses without breach. Routine 'known to police' stops continue without charge.
life_path.headline: Suspended Sentence Lapses

life_path.event: Second Christmas meeting with daughter Shona and grandson, conditional on clean screens, extending the December 2052 Ashgrove Park contact.
life_path.headline: Christmas Family Contact

life_path.event: Recurring supervised contact with daughter and grandson becomes established while the volunteering path stays open. The family tie functions as the primary relapse brake.
life_path.headline: Family Contact Established

life_path.event: Casual cash-in-hand scrapyard labour ceases on physical decline at around 64. Income falls back to benefits pending pension age.
life_path.headline: Casual Work Ends

life_path.event: Relapse to illicit opioid use following a loss of the family contact or of the maintenance structure. Probability is reduced by sustained maintenance but not eliminated given the 30-year history.
life_path.headline: Opioid Relapse

life_path.event: Death at age 70, most probably opioid-related, in the Fallow Edge Estate.
life_path.headline: Death, Fallow Edge

output.overall_assessment: Long-term opioid-dependent recidivist in self-directed recovery. Low economic value, moderate predictability under structured dispensing.

Repeated police stops on 'known to police' grounds
Recovery contingent on single fragile family tie

recommendation.action: Maintain 30ml at fixed 16:00 slot; no taper without review; keep naloxone current.

output.assessment: Subject is presenting at p04 within a stabilised maintenance regime; four negative screens and an active family reconciliation motive support near-term adherence. The residual trajectory risk lies in self-directed tapering and in loss of the daughter contact, either of which reopens the relapse and overdose pathway. Continued structure is the cheaper outcome, and the system records it as care.
